crossRefs.note: He set seventy thousand of them to bear burdens, eighty thousand who were stone cutters in the mountains, and three…
besides Solomon’s chief officers who were over the work, three thousand and three hundred, who ruled over the people…
These were the five hundred fifty chief officers who were over Solomon’s work, who ruled over the people who labored in…

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: These were the chief officers of king Solomon, even two-hundred fifty, who ruled over the people.
translations.bsb: They were also the chief officers for King Solomon: 250 supervisors.
translations.kjv: And these were the chief of king Solomon's officers, even two hundred and fifty, that bare rule over the people.
